name: HorizonLogic

categories.name: Conditional
categories.question: Is the prerequisite satisfied?
categories.description: The next step depends on the actual outcome of the last. Correct orientation, placement and installation unlock completion.
categories.example: Seat the battery correctly before closing the lid.

categories.name: Memory
categories.question: What did the robot see before?
categories.description: Information disappears from view. The robot must retain an identity, location or arrangement through intervening actions.
categories.example: Retrieve the right object after its container is closed.

categories.name: Branching
categories.question: Which action does this state need?
categories.description: Different initial states require different paths. Inspect, repair what is wrong and preserve what is already correct.
categories.example: Right a tipped cup; fetch a spare only when it is missing.

categories.name: Resource allocation
categories.question: How much should each goal receive?
categories.description: Several goals share a finite supply. Allocate ingredients, materials or parts while keeping enough for every goal.
categories.example: Divide a shared supply across two differently sized pizzas.

categories.name: Ordering
categories.question: What has to happen first?
categories.description: Valid action sequences follow physical dependencies. Assembly and packaging require the right parts at the right stage.
categories.example: Place the protective insert before packing and sealing.

tasks.name: Battery orientation
tasks.instruction: Orient the battery so its terminals match the compartment, insert it fully, then place the lid to close the compartment.

tasks.name: Delivery box
tasks.instruction: Pack the cup, jar, water bottle and spoon fully inside the delivery box, then close its lid.

tasks.name: Dishwasher loading
tasks.instruction: Extend the dishwasher rack, load the two large containers in the lower rack and the small container on the upper shelf, then retract the rack and close the door.

tasks.name: Filter installation
tasks.instruction: Insert and turn the filter cartridge to lock it, install the prefilter and retaining collar, then close the cover.

tasks.name: Breakfast table
tasks.instruction: Unfold and level the breakfast table, then place two full cups of water.

tasks.name: Tool retrieval
tasks.instruction: Clear both drawer jams and retrieve all tools.

tasks.name: Toolbox sorting
tasks.actionSemantics: T x 14 dual-arm OSC policy commands
tasks.instruction: Sort the tools into their matching toolbox recesses and close the lid once they are correctly seated.

tasks.name: Vacuum dust cup
tasks.actionSemantics: T x 18 joint/finger absolute position targets; SI units; actuator order below
tasks.instruction: Dual-arm vacuum dust-cup emptying and reinstallation

tasks.name: Fridge restoration
tasks.instruction: Remember where the milk, juice and yogurt belong. Clear the fridge, remove and wipe the shelf, then put the shelf and groceries back in their original places and close the drawer and door.

tasks.name: Hidden-label sorting
tasks.instruction: Inspect and remember the colored labels on both packages. Turn their labels face down and stack the packages on the operating mat. Weigh each package and place it in the station matching its remembered label color.

tasks.name: Ingredient memory
tasks.instruction: Store the two bread slices, meat and vegetable slice in separate drawers and remember their locations. Close all drawers. Then retrieve the ingredients without searching and assemble bread, both fillings in either order, and bread on the board.

tasks.name: Purse memory
tasks.instruction: Put the gold key fob into one purse and remember which purse you used. Close the purses and move them into the cabinet. Then open the purse containing the fob and place the fob in the silver tray without opening the other purses.

tasks.name: Batch delivery
tasks.instruction: Remember the brief notification and complete the entire batch delivery.

tasks.name: Container transfer
tasks.actionSemantics: T x 14 stateful dual-arm OSC commands
tasks.instruction: Remember the target container despite distractions and transport it with both arms.

tasks.name: Display restoration
tasks.instruction: Replace the display mat and restore the original arrangement.

tasks.name: Weight sorting
tasks.instruction: Weigh the objects sequentially, then sort them directly into boxes from memory.

tasks.name: Connector recovery
tasks.instruction: Inspect both pillars and the bridge connector. Remove the bridge first if it obstructs a pillar repair. Seat and align both pillars, then fit the bridge across both pillars, reusing the existing parts.

tasks.name: Cup recovery
tasks.instruction: Prepare an upright cup on the mat. Right the existing cup if it is tipped or upside down; fetch the spare only if the cup is missing. Pour water into the prepared cup and return the bottle upright.

tasks.name: Lunchbox cleanup
tasks.instruction: Inspect the lunchbox. Discard any leftovers in the trash can before wiping any stains with the sponge. Pack the milk carton, fruit, sandwich and snack into their matching compartments, then close the lunchbox.

tasks.name: Table setting
tasks.instruction: Place the white plate inside the boundary on the woven placemat, the blue cup in its cup area, and the spoon in its utensil area. Correct missing, tipped or misoriented items as needed, leaving correctly placed items in place.

tasks.name: Candy packing
tasks.actionSemantics: 18 actuator position targets plus explicit contact-limit mode (19 total); privileged/substep_controls records actual 1kHz actuator targets
tasks.instruction: Continuous spatula holding and portioning candy into three boxes

tasks.name: Jam jar recovery
tasks.instruction: Feedback-driven recovery while handling four jam jars

tasks.name: Lamp installation
tasks.actionSemantics: 18 actuator position targets plus 18 explicit Cartesian force-test parameters (36 total)
tasks.instruction: Table-edge lamp clamping with feedback-guided tightening

tasks.name: Table cleaning
tasks.instruction: Table cleaning with feedback-driven recovery

tasks.name: Boba tea allocation
tasks.instruction: Make two cups of boba milk tea from the shared limited ingredients. Add pearls first, then milk and tea in similar proportions. Inspect the cups and fill each approximately to its marked 75% level, reserving enough ingredients for both.

tasks.name: Flower arrangement
tasks.instruction: Pour water from the shared jug into both vases to approximately their marked levels. Distribute the available flowers between the vases according to their opening sizes, placing each stem inside and leaving both arrangements supported.

tasks.name: Pizza allocation
tasks.instruction: Pour the shared tomato sauce onto both pizza bases and spread it with the brush. Pour cheese onto both pizzas, allocating sauce and cheese in proportion to pizza size. Inspect the coverage and leave the tools and containers safely parked.

tasks.name: Sandwich allocation
tasks.instruction: Make two sandwiches. Distribute the six ready-cut cucumber slices, meat and limited sauce in proportion to the bread sizes. Cut only the meat. Inspect the sauce and add matching bread tops.

tasks.name: Cake decoration
tasks.actionSemantics: T rows of next-state absolute joint positions (including gripper slides). No actuator/dynamic action replay claim.
tasks.instruction: Cake decoration: allocate cream and fruit

tasks.name: Plant repotting
tasks.actionSemantics: T rows of actual actuator position targets; phase, EEF positions and pot counts are before action
tasks.instruction: Plant repotting: allocate finite soil

tasks.name: Repair kits
tasks.actionSemantics: T x 18 actuator joint/finger position targets, ordered by action_names
tasks.instruction: Repair kits: allocate parts across four orders

tasks.name: Shelf display
tasks.actionSemantics: T x 18 joint/finger position targets, with T x 2 grip object-name requests for contact-gated assistance.
tasks.instruction: Display shelves: allocate frames and artwork

tasks.name: Picture frame assembly
tasks.instruction: Place the clear panel, picture facing the front, and backing into the frame. Close both retaining tabs, unfold the stand, then turn the frame upright.

tasks.name: Protective packaging
tasks.instruction: Insert the loose foam pad into the long protective case first, then put the bottle on the pad and the jar into the octagonal case. Close both cases, place them inside the delivery box, then close its outer lid. Either case may be prepared first.

tasks.name: Shelf assembly
tasks.instruction: Assemble both side walls on the base, insert the middle shelf from behind, slide in the back panel, then fit the top.

tasks.name: Table assembly
tasks.instruction: Turn the tabletop over to expose its underside clips. Insert both black leg frames, then turn the assembled table upright and place it in the green area.

tasks.name: Bento packing
tasks.actionSemantics: 18D absolute joint/finger position actuator targets; SI radians/metres; ordered as action_actuators
tasks.instruction: Dual-arm assembly and packing of a two-tier bento box

tasks.name: Picture frame replacement
tasks.actionSemantics: 18D absolute joint/finger position actuator targets; SI radians/metres; ordered exactly as action_actuators
tasks.instruction: Dual-arm wooden picture-frame replacement and upright display

tasks.name: Tea storage
tasks.actionSemantics: 18D absolute joint/finger position actuator targets; SI radians/metres; ordered exactly as action_actuators
tasks.instruction: Dual-arm tea-set cabinet storage: Two teacups and saucers

tasks.name: Toy bridge
tasks.actionSemantics: 18D absolute joint/finger position actuator targets; SI radians/metres; ordered exactly as action_actuators
tasks.instruction: Dual-arm toy-bridge assembly and vehicle crossing

availabilityNote: Drive is a task-record archive for tracking recordings and development history, separate from the LeRobot training datasets. Fridge restoration, lunchbox cleanup and the current cucumber-sandwich variant were not found in the inspected Drive task folders. The legacy lettuce variant is not linked as the current sandwich task.
